The '''BlasterDrive''' was a large, arc-shaped nacelle produced by [[Novaldex/Legends|Novaldex]]. The [[Dagger-D police fighter]], used by the [[Duro Defense Force]], was equipped with a BlasterDive nacelle, which allowed it to travel at speeds of up to 1,200 [[Kilometer per hour/Legends|kilometers per hour]] in [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="CatCW" />
